Applying it uniformly is what makes (i) V3 exact - arms A and B run identical code at full coverage - and (ii) C1/C2/C3 clean, since all three are within-run paired contrasts. The residue is a cross-card caveat: comparing arm A against B1 where B1 had alpha > 0 (pfc, fisher_kpp) carries the chunking difference. debug_notes.diagnosis: Line 33 of 00_contract_screen.sh sourced its sibling shared-config file as `source "$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/_arm_env.sh"`. Under sbatch, SLURM copies ONLY the submitted script into /var/spool/slurmd/job<ID>/ (as `slurm_script`) and executes it from there, so ${BASH_SOURCE[0]}'s dirname is the spool dir and the sibling file is simply not there — the file's own location on NFS is invisible to it. Reproduced deterministically for ALL FOUR sbatch scripts by copying each one alone into a temp dir and running it from cwd=/ (scratchpad/diagnose_attempt_1.sh -> repro_attempt_1_prefix.log): each dies at its own source line (00:33, 01:44, 02:26, 03:36) with exactly the production message, so 01/02/03 carried the identical latent bug and would each have failed the same way once the screen passed. This is invisible to `bash -n` (a syntax check does not resolve `source`) and invisible to any login-node run (where the file IS beside its sibling), which is why the builder's smokes and the reviewer's 7/7 `bash -n` both passed. interpretation: M1 (high confidence) The card repaired stage 2b by scoring the alpha line search against base_oof, but stage 3 both TRAINS and TESTS against the in-sample base (smoke_eval.py:589, 645-656). On cahn_hilliard that base's error is 0.0089 in-sample against 0.4876 at test (55x), so the joint fine-tune re-fits the corrector -- and by gradient descent the gate scalar itself -- to a base 55x better than the one it meets at test. The repair is one stage short: gating OOF while fine-tuning in-sample re-imports the identical defect through the optimiser.

M2 (high confidence) The in-run ratio val_rel_l2_base_oof / val_rel_l2_base_insample is a free, zero-test-data screening statistic for 'is this stage's held-out test trustworthy': 16.4x and 2.9x where stage 3 was kept and hurt, 0.82-1.09x on the three datasets where it never fired.

M3 (medium confidence) The two failure modes differ. On cahn_hilliard the in-sample base is too good, so the keep test under-weights the corrector's real burden. On pfc the corrector, trained against a 0.366-error base, over-corrects a 0.125-error base and the keep test's own baseline (0.2911) is 3.2x WORSE than the honest one (0.0912) -- so part of the +69 % 'gain' is recovery from a bad reference. A correct stage-3 gate must hold the base fixed AND out-of-sample on both sides.

M4 (high confidence) Arm C's top-band behaviour is phase-incoherent full-amplitude injection: the model learned how much high-frequency energy is needed (1.06x) and puts it in the wrong place (cos 0.034), turning a 1.0 into a 1.99. The band where it fails is the band where copy-LF's error is the half-cell resample ramp (s3_warp-B1 F14; the in-run LSI's band_mean_abs_T = 0.121/0.318/0.726/0.971).

M5 (high confidence) Q3 formalised: the self branch's 0.999 is NOT an input gap. The fitted LSI operates on copy-LF alone -- exactly the self branch's query channel -- and scores 0.1128, ~8.9x better. The fidelity gap on fisher_kpp is dominated by a fixed, |k|-dependent, pi/2-phase resampling OPERATOR, and physics-slice pooling summarises the query cloud by content (softmax over slices then a global weighted average), which is shift-variant and phase-destroying: the one operator class it cannot represent. The cross branch does better only because it reads the LF on its native 128^2 grid, where a coarse-to-fine resample is a local interpolation rather than a phase correction. Hence the branch ordering inverts 2511.06294 without contradicting it -- their tasks' useful component is smooth nonlocal mixing, this one's is a resample.

M6 (high confidence) Q4 formalised: the dense arm is a better re-derivation of copy-LF, and copy-LF is a misregistered reference. Because the correction sits in the span of copylf-base, its optimum IS copy-LF (skill 1.0), so no amount of context density can cross the bar; the registration component lives in hf-copylf, where every arm's cosine is ~0. The dense-vs-sparse gain is a copy-LF-reconstruction gain, and A4's degenerate control (a = 1 on every dataset) is the same fact seen from the control side.

M7 (medium confidence) The chunking edit is a real semantic change to the model (the self branch is support-dependent by construction) but a ~1 % score effect and a 35 % correction-field effect. Practical consequence: permute queries before chunking (recovers the unchunked answer to 0.014 % at zero cost); treat any cross-card FIELD comparison between B1 and B2 as confounded, and any score comparison as confounded at the ~1 % level.

M8 (medium confidence) The two 'free win' directions are not the same direction and the difference is spectral: re-registration is near-perfect below 0.5 Nyquist and 5.2x harmful above it, while the fitted T(k) is uniform. Any card that proposes to apply the half-cell fix should band-limit it or fit the taper.
6_analysis.falsification_postmortem: The clause is a conjunction (C1 AND C2 AND C3) and did not fire because C1 held: the OOF gate repair improved sharp__cahn_hilliard 34.53 % (1.9209 skill units, 3.47x its certified floor) on a bit-paired within-run contrast. The mechanism analysis says WHY each part landed where it did. C1 held because the defect it targets is a base-optimism defect and cahn_hilliard is where the base memorises hardest (val in-sample 0.008878 vs OOF 0.145259 vs test 0.487628); the same statistic explains why the pre-registered pfc DOWNSIDE did not materialise -- pfc's optimism is only 2.9x, so the alpha the repaired gate chose (0.99525, within 0.1 % of the pre-registered 0.9944) was close to the test optimum instead of far past it. C2's claim failed on its control leg because the in-run control degenerated to a = 1 (copy-LF), which turns 'beat the control' into 'reach skill < 1'; turn 3 shows why that is unreachable for this arm at any context density -- the correction lives in the span of copylf-base (cos 0.946-0.988) with no hf-copylf component (cos 0.028/0.106/-0.218), so its own optimum is copy-LF. C3 fired, and turns 2-3 give the mechanism: on the hf-copylf target the required operator is a fixed linear shift-invariant resample correction, the attention corrector re-derives only ~62 % of its direction, its self (slice-pooling) branch contributes 0.1 %, and in the top band it injects full-amplitude phase-random energy (cos 0.034) that a 2-parameter filter gets right (cos 0.996). The pre-registered retirement recommendation remains unlicensed -- but the reason it is unlicensed (C1, the gate protocol) is a PROTOCOL result, not an attention result, and turn 1 shows the same protocol defect is still live one stage downstream, where it costs 20-28 % on both arms of this very card.
surprises: S1 The protocol defect this card repaired at the gate is still present at stage 3, and stage 3 only runs BECAUSE the gate was repaired (it is skipped when alpha = 0). The repair therefore unlocked a stage that gives back 5-28 % of it: +0.3605/+0.2892 panel skill units, and a RESOLVABLE +0.9317/+0.6216 on sharp__cahn_hilliard.

S2 The 4096 query chunking changes the correction field by 35 % but the score by 1.25 %, and the unchunked pass is WORSE in the top band (2.532 vs 2.039). Both halves were unexpected: the suspicion was that chunking caused the top-band failure; it does not, and its main visible effect is low-band.
S3 A random query permutation before chunking reproduces the unchunked forward to 0.014 %. The defect is representativeness of the pooling support, not chunking -- a one-line, zero-cost fix.

S4 The zero-parameter re-registration direction is 5.2x WORSE than doing nothing in the top band while removing 97-98 % of the error in bands 1-3. The half-cell fix is not uniformly free, which no previous card recorded.

S5 Arm C's self (physics-slice) branch alone scores skill 0.99904 -- statistically identical to copy-LF -- while emitting a correction at 33 % of the residual RMS.
